annotation_budget.note: Largest eligible noncrowd target box identifies the support subject; query boxes are evaluation only.

limitations: COCO annotations can be incomplete; target-absent labels mean absent from the supplied annotations.
Distinct source photos do not establish different physical instances or independent capture sessions; those IDs are unknown.
Selected categories may have appeared in pretrained encoders; category-disjoint evaluation is not proof of globally unseen categories.
Support subjects are selected using annotated boxes and fixed minimum area/edge requirements; this is an extra annotation resource.
Only six TEST category clusters, recurring query photographs and one procedural pretraining seed.
Own synthetic pretraining is additional training data; not one image total.
Combined detail/triplet objective does not isolate either component.
Primitive-shape curriculum is a control, not the final richer named-shape direction.
OWL external pretraining and potential dataset overlap are not matched to HyperNet.
